cropMethod: Separated connected bodies at alpha > 4 with bounded padding; audited at alpha > 32. Faint shadows below alpha 4 connect nominal cells; exact measured rectangles preserve every physical subject and exclude its neighbors. No pixel manipulation or background removal.

sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent environment sprite atlas for the original painterly RPG Ash & Aether, artisan interiors collection. Create one wide 2:1 landscape image with EXACTLY four equal columns and two equal rows of eight separate, fully contained, complete props. Each object fits inside the central 78% of its cell with generous genuinely transparent gutters, including every tool and shadow. Consistent elevated orthographic camera looking down 35 degrees; fronts and tops visible. Rich original hand-painted fantasy craftsmanship, rounded natural silhouettes, readable fine material texture, weathered ochre clay, warm timber, petrol-blue cloth, aged brass and restrained verdigris; gentle upper-left light with a short soft contact shadow under each object. Every scene object is a single plausible functional arrangement. TOP ROW left to right: 1 a compact apothecary worktable with mortar, herbs, amber glass bottles and folded linen; 2 a small handloom with indigo woven cloth, wooden shuttle and folded yarn; 3 a rounded stone baker's counter with woven bread basket, earthen mixing bowl and flour cloth; 4 a luthier's bench with an unfinished small lute, neatly arranged curved wood parts and brass hand tools. BOTTOM ROW left to right: 5 a low curved archive cabinet with parchment scroll cubbies, clay tablets and one open book; 6 a freestanding drying rack of herbs, flowers and garlic bunches hung from a rough wooden crossbar; 7 a small lived-in round dining table with two ceramic cups, a loaf, one folded blue cloth and a low stool tucked underneath; 8 a narrow timber bed with carved rounded headboard, faded teal quilt, ochre pillow and a small bedside clay lamp. Style cohesive with an atmospheric storybook fantasy action RPG; sophisticated painterly surface detail rather than chunky cartoon shapes. No people, no characters, no text, no labels, no grids, no background wall or floor, no boxed backdrop, no checkerboard; alpha background truly transparent. Clear separate silhouettes with no overlap across cells. Request high-detail wide original artwork.
